name: Turn scattered customer requests into an actionable tracker
query: We're tracking customer requests in https://notion.so/customer-notes and things keep getting lost. Set up a simple tracker under https://notion.so/customer-team so we can see what needs attention, who is handling it, and what is done. Bring over the requests and keep our notes.

sources.https://notion.so/customer-team: Customer team home. No existing request tracker or database is linked here. Notes: https://notion.so/customer-notes.
sources.https://notion.so/customer-notes: Requests from October 1: Acme export issue, Lee is investigating; Birch invoice request, nobody assigned; Cedar login issue, resolved. Follow-up notes: https://notion.so/customer-followup. No deadlines agreed.
sources.https://notion.so/customer-followup: October 3: Birch asked again about the same invoice request from October 1. Still unassigned; no new request.

search_routes.intent: Find an existing customer request tracker in the Customer team area

success_criteria: Creates one simple tracker under the supplied Customer team parent after checking the relevant existing context; does not require the user to specify field names or database types.
Carries over exactly three distinct requests with faithful details and source links, consolidating the two mentions of the Birch invoice request.
Shows Acme as ongoing with Lee's actual identity, Birch as needing attention with no assigned owner, and Cedar as resolved; does not invent dates or commitments.
Creates views that make unresolved requests, ownership of open work, and completed requests easy to find; equivalent names and layouts are acceptable.
Preserves both source-note pages and creates no sample work, unnecessary linked databases, or unsolicited messages.
Checks the populated tracker and returns its link with a brief explanation of how to use it, rather than claiming completion after creating an empty schema.
